# YMA Bouncy Castles

> YMA Bouncy Castles Ltd hires out bouncy castles, soft play, inflatables, garden
> games, obstacle courses and party food machines across East London, North
> London and Essex. Bookings are made online, delivery and setup are included,
> and every inflatable is PIPA-tested and insured.

## Key facts

- Business name: YMA Bouncy Castles Ltd
- Address: 28 Roding Road, Loughton, IG10 3ED, United Kingdom
- Phone: 07951 431111
- Email: info@ymabouncycastles.uk
- Website: https://ymabouncycastles.uk
- Opening hours: 7 days a week, 8am – 7pm
- Service area: East London, North London, Enfield, Essex, Loughton, Chigwell,
  Ilford, Romford, Walthamstow and more than 100 surrounding localities
  (see https://ymabouncycastles.uk/locations)
- Catalogue: 51 hire items, including bouncy castles, soft play sets, disco
  domes, slides, obstacle courses, garden games and fun food machines
- Prices: from £20 to £250 per hire, average around £118
- Delivery: free delivery between 8am and 12pm, free collection after 5pm;
  a specific delivery time window costs from £10
- Placement: setting up outdoors on a hard surface or artificial grass adds £10;
  grass and indoor setups are free
- Payment: cash on delivery or bank transfer (no online card payment)
- Safety: PIPA-tested inflatables, public liability insurance, set up and
  collected by our own team
- Booking: online at https://ymabouncycastles.uk/booking-catalog

## Common questions

- How much does it cost to hire a bouncy castle? Prices start at £20 and average
  around £118 per hire. Delivery in the standard 8am–12pm window and collection
  after 5pm are free.
  (https://ymabouncycastles.uk/blog/how-much-is-it-to-hire-a-bouncy-castle)
- Which areas are covered? East London, North London, Enfield and Essex, with
  more than 100 localities covered individually.
- Are the inflatables safe? All are PIPA-tested, insured, and set up by the
  company's own staff.
- Can I book online? Yes — the whole catalogue is bookable at
  https://ymabouncycastles.uk/booking-catalog
